name: TIP Countdown Generator
author: alexvtn

sections.description:
TIP Countdown Generator is designed for marketers, creators, educators, agencies, and WordPress site owners who want to add real urgency to their promotional pages.

The plugin helps you create countdown timers for limited-time offers, webinars, product launches, closing carts, and evergreen promotions. You can show the same deadline to everyone or start a personal timer from each visitor’s first visit.

It is useful when you want to:

  • make a deadline clear and visible.
  • highlight the time left for an offer.
  • create evergreen campaigns without manually changing dates.
  • show consistent timers across multiple pages of the same funnel.

Each countdown can be customized from the admin area and added through a shortcode.

For Evergreen countdowns, the plugin keeps the timer consistent over time using tracking methods such as cookies, IP, or a cookie/IP combination, so visitors do not see the countdown restart on every visit.

Premium features

PRO templates
You can use 3 additional templates with a different animation.

Recurring countdowns
Create countdowns that repeat on a schedule with duration and restart-delay controls.

Action on expiry
Choose what happens when a countdown expires, including hiding the timer, showing a message, or redirecting visitors.

Dynamic shortcode generator
Generate customized shortcode parameters from a dedicated interface.

Option to duplicate a countdown
Create a copy of an existing countdown and adjust it without rebuilding the settings from scratch.

Logged-in user tracking
Tie evergreen countdown progress to the WordPress user account instead of only cookie or IP data.

Advanced recurring availability rules
Control what visitors see before the countdown starts and on days that are not selected in a recurring schedule.

You can get the premium version from the link below:
https://www.themeinprogress.com/tip-countdown-generator-pro

You can see an example of all templates from the link below:
https://demo.themeinprogress.eu/tip-countdown-generator-pro/documentation-pro-version/templates//
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open the TIP Countdown Generator panel to create and manage timers.
